predecessors.text: the border areas outside the republic's control in late 1962 (a US chargé: the republican regime was 'in full control of the country, except in some border areas'); the extent is the researcher's…

successors.name: North Yemen
successors.text: the north and east of Yemen, where the royalists made peace with the republic in 1970

ledger.x: 26 September 1962: the royalists take the field against the republic.
1963: Marib and Harib fall to the Egyptians.
November 1967: the royalists surround Sanaa, take its main airport and cut the Hodeida road; the siege was lifted by February 1968.
February 1968: the siege of Sanaa is lifted; 'the republicans had essentially won the war'.

wars.name: North Yemen Civil War
wars.outcome: The republicans, helped by Egyptian troops, outlasted the royalists, who were backed by Saudi Arabia and Jordan; the siege of Sanaa was lifted by February 1968 and Saudi Arabia recognized the republic in 1970.

certainty.note: Front lines of a guerrilla war, moving with each offensive; no page opened gives a boundary.
